Hero.tagline: Start today on your way to becoming a professional beach volleyball athlete.
Hero.ballAlt: Beach volleyball — Club de Voley Playa

Why.quote: Trophies belong in a box: the best prize is what we learn, and sooner or later that has to be passed on.
Why.text: For years Juli has been turning this idea over: a virtual space where anyone can learn beach volleyball — technique, fitness and mindset — from the very basics to the details you only learn by competing. Today you can start becoming a professional player.

Bio.p1: At 13 I played my first beach volleyball tournament and never wanted to leave the sand. From that day my career split in two: indoor in winter, beach in summer.
Bio.firstTournamentAlt: Juli as a kid at their first beach volleyball tournament
Bio.p2: In 2011 the best and most awaited offer of my career arrived: I joined the Argentine national team. That's when the dreams of little Juli began to come true.
Bio.p3: In 2021 I achieved the big dream: I competed at the Tokyo Olympic Games.
Bio.tokyoAlt: Juli at the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Village, representing the Argentine national team
Bio.cred4: Specialization in high-performance sports psychology — Barça Innovation Hub
